name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, Niva Bupa Health Insurance Ltd is a Tech driven leading health insurer in India. [1]
key_points: Leading Insurance Company: Niva Bupa Health Insurance is one of the major players among private standalone health insurers in India. In FY25, the company held a gross direct premium income (GDPI) market share of ~5.31% in the health insurance segment and 17.59% among standalone private health insurers. Co received its license from the IRDAI on Feb 15, 2010 and commenced operations in Mar 2010. [1]

profile.summary: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited provides health insurance products in India. It offers health insurance plans, such as individual, family, NRIs, senior citizens, personal accident, critical illness, disease-specific, hospital cash, and maternity insurance; travel insurance plans, including international and studying abroad insurance; and corporate insurance plans comprising group and start up health, group personal accident, and OPD coverage, as well as group health insurance claim process. The company was formerly known as Max Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited and changed its name to Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited in July 2021. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Gurugram, India. Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Bupa Singapore Holdings Pte. Ltd.
